task.description:
Design ISS-204 and ISS-206. Write TWO prose design docs (Type E):

1. src/design/iss204_audit_in_transaction.md
   ISS-204: Write audit_log inside the state-change transaction.
   Current: audit INSERT is post-handler middleware in a SEPARATE transaction.
   Fix: enlist audit INSERT in the handler's own transaction (commits/rolls back with it).
   - before_state/after_state captured within the same transaction
   - post-handler middleware no longer performs audit write
   - crash between event commit and old audit point: both present or both absent
   Touchpoints: src/api/middleware/*, src/obs/audit.zig, all state-changing route handlers

2. src/design/iss206_token_multiset_join_counters.md
   ISS-206: Engine token multiset + persisted parallel-join counters.
   ISS-105 schema is already RELEASED (active_tokens as [{token_id,node_id}], join_counters JSONB).
   This issue is the ENGINE LOGIC on top of that schema.
   - InstanceState carries active_tokens: []Token{token_id,node_id} and join_counters
   - PARALLEL split assigns fresh token_ids
   - Join increments persisted counter; advances only when active-branch count reached (cancelled branches subtracted)
   - Loops/reconverging branches keep correct multiplicity
   - Replay reproduces exact token arrangement
   Touchpoints: src/engine/transition.zig, src/engine/instance.zig

No implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: iss204 design: transactional audit path described, middleware change described, crash-safety stated
iss206 design: token multiset logic, parallel split, join counter algorithm, replay invariant all described
No implementation code in either doc
